title: Land and Water
text:
A river is a large stream of water. It flows from high land to the sea or to a lake. Many cities are built near rivers because people need water. A mountain is very high land with rocks and snow on top.

A desert is a dry place with little rain. Deserts can be hot in the day and cold at night. Some animals live in the desert, such as camels. An island is land with water all around it.

questions.text: What does a river flow to?

options: A very high land with snow
A dry place with little rain
Land with water all around it

questions.text: What can we infer about people who live in a desert?
options: They have a lot of rain
They may find it hard to get water
They live on top of a mountain

questions.text: Why might it be hard to walk from one island to another?
options: Because the islands are very small
Because the islands are very hot
Because there is water between them

vocabulary.definition: a large natural stream of water
a very high area of land
a dry area with very little rain
a piece of land surrounded by water

paragraph_translations: Nehir büyük bir su akıntısıdır. Yüksek topraklardan denize veya bir göle doğru akar. Birçok şehir, insanların suya ihtiyacı olduğu için nehirlerin yakınına kurulur. Dağ, tepesinde kayalar ve kar bulunan çok yüksek bir arazidir.
Çöl, az yağmur alan kuru bir yerdir. Çöller gündüz sıcak, gece ise soğuk olabilir. Develer gibi bazı hayvanlar çölde yaşar. Ada, etrafı tamamen su ile çevrili bir karadır.
